notes.title: Pixel Happy Game Girls: Update 1.5 notes
notes.notes:
We did a few major things in this update!

- Changed font for the in-game dialogue to Atkinson Hyperlegible, this makes the game more accessible
- Added additional voice lines for the characters, particularly Sora and Kai.
- Added and removed dialogue to make the story flow better.
- For Deluxe Pack owners, we moved the content to its own separate folder to make things more organized.
